contradictions.description: The 2026-06-30 AP aging totals $37,994.00, but the trial balance and ledger show Accounts Payable of $54,775.08. The $16,781.08 difference is the unpaid remainder of opening payables ($33,562.15 opening balance less the $16,781.07 payment on 2026-04-06), which is omitted from the AP aging.

w13-accrual_schedule.reason: The May prepaid schedule and insurance and software contracts establish each opening balance, addition, monthly amortization, and June closing balance, while the GL confirms June amortization is not yet booked.

w13-bank_rec.reason: The bank statement, cash ledger, and trial balance provide sufficient information to identify outstanding payments, deposits in transit, and the unrecorded bank service fee and to reconcile both sides uniquely.

w13-journal_entries.reason: The payroll register, prepaid support, fixed-asset register, vendor documents, and GL provide sufficient information to identify missing entries while avoiding duplicate depreciation and bank-side corrections.

w13-variance_analysis.reason: June actual activity can be adjusted for the checklist close entries and compared with the June budget; the material one-off expense drivers are supported by specific vendor bills.
